recorded.prompt:q-bound: Read the whole lesson page, then this question. Using only what the page states, which option does the page decide is correct? Quote or cite the deciding passage.
recorded.outcome:q-bound: "lower = lp.objective_value() / max(worth, 1.0)  # no plan uses fewer days than this" and "z_RMP / v* <= z_LP <= z_RMP". 50.4 / 1.2 = 42.0.
recorded.prompt:q-integer: Read the whole lesson page, then this question. Using only what the page states, which option does the page decide is correct? Quote or cite the deciding passage.
recorded.outcome:q-integer: "The best integer plan may need a pattern the LP never priced, and then the integer master over the generated columns ends above ceil(z_LP) with no proof either way ... The honest report in that case is the interval [ceil(z_LP), z_IP]." That interval is [62, 63].
recorded.prompt:q-compact: Read the whole lesson page, then this question. Using only what the page states, which option does the page decide is correct? Quote or cite the deciding passage.
recorded.outcome:q-compact: Its LP may split a 340-minute widening across two days; the pattern LP cannot, because every column is a whole day that really fits.

recorded.prompt:q-bound:b: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-bound:b: The bound divides by the pricing value and does not subtract it: "z_RMP / v* <= z_LP". The code is "lp.objective_value() / max(worth, 1.0)".
recorded.prompt:q-bound:c: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-bound:c: The bounds meet only when "the best day is worth exactly 1, no day has a negative reduced cost". A day worth 1.2 means the loop has not ended. An example is "[31.938, 33.5] after iteration 4".
recorded.prompt:q-bound:d: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-bound:d: "z_LP <= z_RMP". The restricted master is the upper side, and the master LP only falls ("The master LP falls from 41.467 to 33.1").
recorded.prompt:q-integer:b: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-integer:b: "The best integer plan may need a pattern the LP never priced ... with no proof either way. Closing that gap exactly needs branch-and-price."
recorded.prompt:q-integer:c: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-integer:c: ceil(z_LP) is a lower bound only. The integer master can end "above ceil(z_LP) with no proof either way". In the page's example, reaching it "is luck of the data, not a property of the method".
recorded.prompt:q-integer:d: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-integer:d: "Because a crew-day count is a whole number, the LP optimum 33.1 proves that no plan uses fewer than 34 crew-days." A fractional count is an LP answer, not a plan.
recorded.prompt:q-compact:a: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-compact:a: a yes/no $`u_j`$ per day, cover rows, a 600-minute row per day
recorded.prompt:q-compact:c: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-compact:c: **Variables.** Master LP: $`\lambda_p \ge 0`$, continuous ... column generation LP   33.100 — the pattern LP is continuous and its value is fractional, not rounded
recorded.prompt:q-compact:d: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-compact:d: at iteration 6 the best day is worth exactly 1, no day has a negative reduced cost, and the two meet.
